question: Who won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, and for what discovery?
text:
**Mary E. Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell, and Shimon Sakaguchi** shared the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine “for their discoveries concerning peripheral immune tolerance.” ([nobelprize.org](https://www.nobelprize.org/uploads/2025/10/press-medicineprize2025.pdf?utm_source=openai))

Sakaguchi discovered **regulatory T cells**, which help prevent the immune system from attacking the body’s own tissues. Brunkow and Ramsdell identified the **FOXP3** gene and linked mutations in it to severe autoimmune disease. Sakaguchi then showed that the gene is essential for the development of regulatory T cells. ([nobelprize.org](https://www.nobelprize.org/uploads/2025/10/press-medicineprize2025.pdf?utm_source=openai))
